description:
Build an admin-facing dashboard summarising:
- open `payment_anomaly_log` rows by type and age
- reconciliation ticker last-run timestamp and last-pass success counts
- authorization-vs-fulfillment ratios over time
- recent webhook processing failures
- credit adjustment volume

Provides the at-a-glance evidence operators need before monetization scales. Lowest-priority action because the underlying data is already visible via the per-entity views in execute/lpbs-admin-payment-ops; the dashboard is the aggregation layer.
name: lpbs-monetization-dashboard
title: Admin monetization dashboard aggregating anomalies, reconciliation state, and fulfillment metrics
